ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r1.claim: The term yakhaafuun means yarjuun here; because disbelievers neither fear nor expect the Hereafter, no sign can persuade them, and even open scrolls would bring another excuse.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p59/r1.anchor: since they have no fear of the Hereafter and their heart’s desire is also to have no fear of it

NAHHAS:v5p74/r8.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p74/r8.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p74/r8.claim: Assimilation is required here because the first consonant is vowelless.
NAHHAS:v5p74/r8.anchor: لا يجوز إلا الإدغام لأن الأول ساكن

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p356#3/r6.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p356#3/r6.speaker: author
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p356#3/r6.claim: With yāʾ, the subject is carried over from بل يريد كل امرئ منهم.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p356#3/r6.anchor: فالحجة لمن قرأه بالياء أنه رده على قوله بل يريد كل امرىء منهم

IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p356#3/r7.author: Ibn Khālawayh (attr.)
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p356#3/r7.speaker: author
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p356#3/r7.claim: With tāʾ, the people are directly addressed.
IBNKHALAWAYH-HUJJA:v1p356#3/r7.anchor: والحجة لمن قرأه بالتاء أنه جعلهم مخاطبين فدل عليهم بالتاء

ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r1.claim: Kallā rebukes their wish and restrains them from demanding signs: their actual motive is that they do not fear the afterlife, so they turn away from the admonition.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r1.anchor: ردععن إرادتهم تلك وزجر لهم عن اقتراح الآيات بلا لا يخافون الآخرة فلذلك يعرضون عن التذكرة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r2.claim: Their refusal is not caused by the unavailability of pages or the granting of their proposal, despite their claim.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r2.anchor: لا لامتناع إيتاء الصحف وحصول مقترحهم كما يزعمون

ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r3.speaker: أبو حيوة
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r3.claim: Abū Ḥaywa reads takhāfūn with second-person tāʾ, shifting the address to the listeners.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p134#4/r3.anchor: وقرأ أبو حيوة تخافون بتاء الخطاب التفاتا

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r1.claim: Kallā means no, they will not receive scrolls; it can also mean truly wherever it occurs.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r1.anchor: فقال الله تعالى: {كلا} لا يؤتون الصحف. وقيل: حقا، وكل ما ورد عليك منه فهذا وجهه

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r2.claim: They do not fear afterlife punishment; fearing the Fire would prevent demanding signs after proofs were established.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p275/r2.anchor: {بل لا يخافون الآخرة} أي لا يخافون عذاب الآخرة، والمعنى أنهم لو خافوا النار لما اقترحوا هذه الآيات بعد قيام الأدلة.

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r5.claim: The first kalla rebukes their demand for signs.

BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r6.claim: They turn away from the reminder because they do not fear the hereafter, not because they were refused scrolls.
BAYDAWI-FULL:74:50-56/r6.anchor: فلذلك أعرضوا عن التذكرة لا لامتناع إيتاء الصحف

BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r6.claim: Their real reason for turning away is that they do not fear the Hereafter.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p238/r6.anchor: علتهم الحقيقية في هذا الإعراض أنهم

DURR-FULL:v8p340/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p340/r3.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p340/r3.claim: Qatada says their lack of fear and belief in the Hereafter is what made them laugh and ruined them.
DURR-FULL:v8p340/r3.anchor: وفي قوله: {كلا بل لا يخافون الآخرة} قال: ذلك الذي أضحك بالقوم وأفسدهم

DURR-FULL:v8p340/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p340/r6.speaker: الحسن
DURR-FULL:v8p340/r6.claim: Al-Hasan says their failure to fear the Hereafter is what exposed them.
DURR-FULL:v8p340/r6.anchor: عن الحسن رضي الله عنه {كلا بل لا يخافون الآخرة} قال: هذا الذي فضحهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p331/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p331/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p331/r6.claim: The transition rejects another claim: their demand is only evasion, since they would not believe even if given a document; they do not fear the afterlife.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p331/r6.anchor: ثم أضرب على كلامهم بإبطال آخر بحرف الإضراب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p331/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p331/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p331/r7.claim: Their lack of fear is a metonym for disbelief in the afterlife; denial of resurrection underlies their rejection of the Qur’an.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p331/r7.anchor: أي لا يؤمنون بها فكني عن عدم الإيمان بالآخرة بعدم الخوف منها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r3.claim: كلا rejects the objectors' demand; their real cause for turning away and perishing is that they do not fear the afterlife.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r3.anchor: كلا رد على إرادتهم أي ليس الأمر كذلك

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r4.speaker: أبو حيوة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r4.claim: Abu Haywa reads تخافون with second-person tāʾ; it is also reported from Ibn Amir.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p400/r4.anchor: وقرأ أبو حيوة: «تخافون» بالتاء من فوق رويت عن ابن عامر

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p413#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p413#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p413#2/r1.claim: They do not fear the punishment of the Hereafter; if they feared the Fire, they would not demand signs after the proof had already been established.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p413#2/r1.anchor: بل لا يخافون الآخرة أي لا يخشون عذابها والمعنى أنهم لو خافوا النار لما اقترحوا الآيات بعد قيام الدلالة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p273#2/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p273#2/r8.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p273#2/r8.claim: Their corruption stems from disbelief in the Hereafter and denial that it will occur.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p273#2/r8.anchor: أي: إنما أفسدهم عدم إيمانهم بها، وتكذيبهم بوقوعها.

JISHUMI:v10p7170/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r3.claim: All read third person except a report of Ibn ʿĀmir's second person; the author calls it erroneous and says Ibn ʿĀmir's sound reading matches the rest.
JISHUMI:v10p7170/r3.anchor: وكلهم قرؤوا: بل لا يخافون بالياء سوى ابن عامر، فروي عنه بالتاء، وقيل: هو غلط عنه،

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r17.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r17.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r17.claim: Their real reason for turning away from the reminder is that they do not fear the Hereafter, not that the requested sheets were withheld.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p657#2/r17.anchor: فلذلك أعرضوا عن التذكرة لا لامتناع إيتاء الصحف

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.speaker: رسول الله
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet promises ten good deeds for each person in Mecca who believed in Muhammad or disbelieved in him to whoever recites al-Muddaththir; no grading is stated.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p658/r3.anchor: من قرأ سورة المدثر أعطاه الله عشر حسنات بعدد من صدق بمحمد وكذب به بمكة

MUQATIL:74:53-56/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:74:53-56/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:74:53-56/r1.claim: They do not fear the punishment of the afterlife.

BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r5.claim: The first kalla rebukes their obstinate demand for signs, which seeks defiance rather than guidance; their real cause is lack of fear of the Hereafter, being consumed by love of this world.

BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r6.claim: Their rejection stems from not fearing the next life, not from the failure to receive individual heavenly pages.
BURSEVI:v10p187#2/r6.anchor: فلعدم خوفهم منها أعرضوا عن التذكرة لا لامتناع إيتاء الصحف

NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#12/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#12/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#12/r1.claim: “No indeed” rebukes their demand for individually delivered pages and their proposal of signs.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#12/r1.anchor: ردع لهم عن تلك الإرادة وزجر عن اقتراح الآيات

NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#12/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#12/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#12/r2.claim: They turned away from the reminder because they do not fear the afterlife, not because they were denied the pages they demanded.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p298#12/r2.anchor: فلذلك اعرضوا عن التذكرة لا لامتناع ايتاء الصحف

QURTUBI-FULL:74:52-53/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:52-53/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:52-53/r8.claim: Kalla means their demand will not be granted; al-Qurtubi prefers this refutation over the alternative ‘indeed.’
QURTUBI-FULL:74:52-53/r8.anchor: كلا } أي ليس يكون ذلك. وقيل: حقا. والأول أجود لأنه رد لقولهم.

QURTUBI-FULL:74:52-53/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:74:52-53/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:74:52-53/r9.claim: They will not receive what they wish because they do not fear the Hereafter and are deluded by worldly life.
QURTUBI-FULL:74:52-53/r9.anchor: أي لا أعطيهم ما يتمنون لأنهم لا يخافون الآخرة، اغترارا بالدنيا.

RAZI-FULL:v30p187#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#3/r1.claim: “No indeed” rebukes their demand for that special revelation and stops their proposing further signs.
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#3/r1.anchor: كلا } وهو ردع لهم عن تلك الإرادة ، وزجر عن اقتراح الآيات

RAZI-FULL:v30p187#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#3/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#3/r2.claim: They turned from reflection because they do not fear the afterlife; the many miracles already sufficed to establish prophethood, so demanding more is obstinate.
RAZI-FULL:v30p187#3/r2.anchor: فلذلك أعرضوا عن التأمل ، فإنه لما حصلت المعجزات الكثيرة ، كفت في الدلالة على صحة النبوة

STUDYQURAN:74:53/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r1.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r1.claim: The emphatic particle kallā can also mean “truly” or “indeed,” a rendering that suits verse 54 better than verse 53.
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r1.anchor: In both verses nay, translating the emphatic particle kallā, could also be rendered “truly” or “indeed,” an alternative that fits v. 54 better than v. 53 (Q).

STUDYQURAN:74:53/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r2.speaker: Ibn ʿĀmir
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r2.claim: Ibn ʿĀmir reads “you fear not” rather than “they fear not,” turning the phrase into a warning to the reader or listener.
STUDYQURAN:74:53/r2.anchor: In the recitation of Ibn ʿĀmir, they fear not is read, “you fear not,” as a warning to the reader or listener.

TAB-FULL:v23p462/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p462/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p462/r1.claim: The scroll demand is not what would make them believe: they disregard God's punishment and deny resurrection, reward, and punishment, so they turn from God's reminder and revelation.
TAB-FULL:v23p462/r1.anchor: ما الأمر كما يزعمون من أنهم لو أوتوا صحفا منشرة صدقوا، بل لا يخافون الآخرة

TAB-FULL:v23p462/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p462/r2.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p462/r2.claim: Qatāda says their failure to believe and fear the Hereafter is what corrupted them.
TAB-FULL:v23p462/r2.anchor: عن قتادة، قوله: {كلا بل لا يخافون الآخرة}

TABATABAI:74:53/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:53/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:53/r6.claim: Kalla rebukes their insistence that every person receive a heavenly book; the prophet's call is already supported by a complete proof for everyone.
TABATABAI:74:53/r6.anchor: ردع لهم بما يريدونه من نزول كتاب سماوي على كل واحد منهم

TABATABAI:74:53/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:53/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:53/r7.claim: Prophethood also requires purity of essence and a fit soul, qualities other people lack; this answers the demand for equal individual books, as in God's reply that He knows where to place His message.
TABATABAI:74:53/r7.anchor: أن الرسالة تحتاج من طهارة الذات وصلاحية النفس إلى ما يفقده نفوس سائر الناس

TABATABAI:74:53/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:74:53/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:74:53/r8.claim: The evidence is fully established for the messenger and the rest alike, with no need for each addressee to receive individual pages.
TABATABAI:74:53/r8.anchor: فالحجة تامة قائمة على الرسول وغيره على حد سواء من غير حاجة إلى أن يؤتى كل واحد من الناس المدعوين صحفا منشرة

TABRISI:74:49-56/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:74:49-56/r12.speaker: author
TABRISI:74:49-56/r12.claim: They reject the reality of the afterlife; if they feared its punishment, they would not demand signs after proofs and miracles were established.
TABRISI:74:49-56/r12.anchor: بجحدهم صحتها ولو خافوا عذاب الآخرة لما اقترحوا الآيات

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p464/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p464/r7.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p464/r7.claim: Muqatil says no: they will not be given the pages.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r1.speaker: عطاء
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r1.claim: ʿAta glosses the afterlife here as the Fire and its punishment.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r2.claim: If they feared the afterlife, they would not demand signs after proof and the clear miracle; their demands show they do not fear the Fire.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p465/r2.anchor: والمعنى: أنهم لو (¬11) خافوا الآخرة لما اقترحوا الآيات بعد قيام الدلالة ووضوح المعجزة

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r6.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r6.claim: The rejection answers their proposal for spread-out books; they make such demands because they do not fear the Hereafter.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:74:49-56/r6.anchor: كلا } رد لما قالوا { بل لا يخافون الآخرة } حيث يقترحون أن يؤتوا صحفا منشرة.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r4.claim: Their refusal stems from disbelief in the afterlife, where all will answer for their deeds; accountability requires a responsible life, while they insisted on following desire without fear of sin or reckoning.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r4.anchor: Çünkü âhirette herkes dünyada yapıp ettiklerinden dolayı sorguya çekilecektir. Şu halde bu inanç, hayatı bütünüyle sorumluluk bilinci içinde geçirmeyi gerektirir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r5.claim: Their denial and stubbornness toward Islam and the Prophet rest on a psychology of avoiding responsibility.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:74:49/r5.anchor: İşte âyet onların İslâm ve peygamber karşısındaki inkâr ve inatlarının temelinde böyle bir sorumsuzluk psikolojisinin bulunduğunu göstermektedir.
